name: trade-bot-hyperliquid-perp
description: Decides a Hyperliquid perpetual from a market name, candle interval, candle count, and one technical-analysis type. A contract address is rejected, and the name does not have to be a saved asset. A clear idea returns an unsigned open or close payload. The same direction or no clear idea does nothing. A failed momentum or candlestick confirmation blocks an open and still allows a close. Dry-run and backtest do not use real USDC.
